class_notes.A: 187 active NNI-registered Nunavut businesses enumerable at /business/list. Caveat: NNI subset only, not complete Nunavut business population
class_notes.B: Effective date on list + profile enables new-registration detection via snapshot diff. Effective date = renewal date not founding date
class_notes.C: Profile pages: phone, email, contact name, employee count (integer), postal code, address, sector+goods+services classification. First source in this research with individual employee count + full contact info

ingestion_pattern.step_1: GET /business/list — returns 187 rows: name, effective_date, community, profile_id
ingestion_pattern.step_2: GET /business/profile/{id} for each — returns full structured field set
ingestion_pattern.step_3: Store raw employee_count integer, derive size bucket in pipeline
ingestion_pattern.step_4: Snapshot diff on effective_date for new-registration detection
